seo.title: Molecision S6 — digital PCR system Snibe | LabWell
seo.description: Molecision S6 is a Snibe digital PCR system for nucleic acid quantification: 16 samples per run and 5 fluorescence channels. Supplied by LabWell in Ukraine.

T2_hero.lead: Designed for nucleic acid quantification in a modular configuration tailored to the laboratory workflow. The system processes 16 samples per run.

T3_about.h2: What Molecision S6 is and who it is for
T3_about.text: Molecision S6 is a Snibe digital PCR system for nucleic acid quantification. It processes 16 samples per run through five fluorescence channels, while its modular configuration can be arranged for the laboratory workflow. According to Snibe, a run takes approximately 2.5 hours and generates more than 25,000 droplets.

items.text: The modular configuration can be arranged around the laboratory workflow. This allows the configuration to reflect how the laboratory organizes its testing.
Five fluorescence channels are available for nucleic acid quantification. The system processes 16 samples in each run.
According to Snibe, the system generates more than 25,000 droplets per run. This figure should be assessed in the context of the specific assay protocol.
